messages: I hear #p103#'s found herself a new life ambition...

Last time, I got #p103# some mushroom caps to help convince her dad to let her travel. Apparently, it didn't work. Now, she has a new dream: she wants to be an alchemist! A bit fickle, but whatever. She told me she needed certain materials to pursue her dreams... and I already knew exactly what she was going to ask for. She wants me to collect #b1 #t2022000##k, #b25 #t4000036##k, and #b25 #t4000039##k by defeating monsters, so she can make some #t2000004#s.
I got the materials #p103# needed to make some #t2000004#s. If she fails... is the whole place going to blow up?
name: Jane's First Challenge
